_source: DeliveryFeeCalculatorService (app.order.* defaults and the app_config keys that override them), V34__fixed_categories_platform_fee.sql, and VendorDeliveryThresholdService.DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_FALLBACK.
_why: The estimator on the public site runs the SAME arithmetic the backend runs, rather than an approximation of it. If a number here stops matching the service, the site starts lying about what an order costs — so each value names the exact constant it mirrors.
_freeRangeKm: app.order.free-range-km, overridable by app_config['delivery.free_range_km']. The base fee covers everything inside this.
_petrolPriceInrPerL: app.order.default-petrol-price. In production this is the city's fuel price for the day, updated by an admin; this is the fallback the service uses when there is no entry.
_defaultFreeDeliveryThresholdInr: VendorDeliveryThresholdService.DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_FALLBACK. Each vendor sets their own per category; this is what applies until they do.
_categories: V34__fixed_categories_platform_fee.sql — the five fixed categories and their platform_fee_percent.
